verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no native Slack, Notion, or Zapier integration. What it does show is a generic plumbing path: webhooks that POST meeting summaries, transcripts, and action items to any URL, plus REST API endpoints and SDKs. These could feed those tools only through custom building or third-party glue. Missing for 10: documented native Slack channel posting, Notion page sync, a Zapier app or connector, and any hands-on corroboration of notes landing in those tools.
